item.title: How Stacker Helps PR Agencies Become Unstoppable
item.description: The demand for media coverage has never been higher — especially as AI increasingly surfaces earned media — yet newsrooms continue to shrink. PR professionals are working harder than ever to break through, as brands search for new ways to get seen.

item.title: Stacker Wrapped: Data Dives, Cultural Coverage and Other Trends from the Stacker Wire in 2025
item.description: The Stacker Connect newswire reached escape velocity in 2025, rocketing to more than 300 stories syndicated per month to the thousands of publishers in our network, 3x the number from the beginning of the year and 10x the number from only a year earlier.

item.title: Green Flags: Learnings from Portal 3.0 Illuminate What Industry Leaders Need Now
item.description: Across PR, content, and comms teams, budgets are stagnant while expectations mount. According to a new study from Meltwater and WE Communications, only about 2 in 5 company leaders fully understand their PR team's work.

item.title: The Perception Gap: What Publishers Think Readers Want vs. What Actually Performs
item.description: Stacker’s aim has always been to enhance coverage for publishers for free. Our newswire provides publishing partners with high-quality, non-advertorial stories from editorial teams at both nonprofits and brands, in line with our belief that great content can come from a variety of sources. But the content publishers are looking for doesn’t always align with the highest-performing stories.

item.title: Stacker and Scrunch Are Teaming Up to Make AI Search Visibility More Measurable
item.description: With the rise of AI platforms and zero-click search, brand visibility is increasingly shaped by what AI search surfaces and cites. Identifying where those citations come from and why, has become the focus for marketing and communication teams in 2026.

item.title: From the Newsroom: What Publishers Picked Up in January
item.description: January tends to feel like 301 days instead of 31–it’s something about the crash-out from the hustle and bustle of the holidays and return to monotony, combined with dropping temperatures and shorter days.

item.title: Media Relations Are Becoming "Machine Relations" — And Most Brands Aren't Ready
item.description: As marketing and content teams wrapped up 2025 and set their 2026 strategies, there was an onslaught of predictions and thought leadership about how brand marketing is evolving in the age of AI.

item.title: The Citation Economy: Why AI Rewards Brands with a Distribution Strategy
item.description: We've well and truly entered the citation economy– at least when it comes to brand discovery and authority building.

item.title: Story Hub Is Evolving to Meet the New Reality of Digital Publishing
item.description: The digital publishing landscape is undergoing one of its fastest transformations in decades.

item.title: New Updates, New Partners, Same Editorial Standards
item.description: Since its inception, one of Stacker’s core values has been providing news organizations with trusted editorial content at no cost. But over the last decade, the outlets that make up our network of 3,000+ publishers have undergone massive amounts of change, from industry headwinds to shifting audience habits and wavering trust.
